direction: A concise functional product film: establish the mark, show a single user task from prompt through visible work to result, prove three capabilities in a rhythmic insert run, then close cleanly.

shots.title: 01 · Logo reveal
shots.purpose: Brand recognition without a text preamble.
shots.camera: Short optical reveal; stop on the mark.

shots.title: 02 · One clear brief
shots.purpose: Show the actual home composer taking a concise Forma brief and submitting it.
shots.camera: Establish the real control, track the typing front, land on one send beat.

shots.title: 03 · Work, then proof
shots.purpose: Compress the waiting while keeping operation order and the completed reply/change card legible.
shots.camera: A single top-to-bottom timeline scan; no repeated pauses.

shots.title: 04 · Current session workspace
shots.purpose: Re-establish the complete latest split layout before detail inserts.
shots.camera: Pull to a steady wide shot showing the chat pane and real preview shell together.

shots.title: 05 · Refine with GPT-6 Luna
shots.purpose: Show the selected GPT-6 Luna demo model and one compact follow-up instruction.
shots.camera: Match the composer, follow the second typing front, punch to submit.

shots.title: 06 · Result changes
shots.purpose: Let the visible website change land and hold long enough to register.
shots.camera: A restrained palette reveal followed by a stable result frame.

shots.title: 07 · Three fast proofs
shots.purpose: Prove inspect, source diff, and version switching as three distinct actions.
shots.camera: Three motivated macro inserts with clean directional handoffs; no feature-card hold.

shots.title: 08 · Brand close
shots.purpose: Return to the mark and leave a clean end hold.
shots.camera: Quick pullback, then locked brand frame.

audio.transitionSfx: One short air cue per scene handoff; UI clicks only on visible interactions.

editorialBoundaries: The execution sequence is explicitly time-compressed; elapsed performance is not claimed.
The Forma website, agent timeline, selected model, and version states remain deterministic demonstration fixtures, not a live provider run.
No large overhead headline; the opening and closing use brand identity only.
